purpose: Dated review and preservation snapshot, not a live dashboard or catalog completion claim.

status_definitions.complete: Gate-verified status already recorded in the captured pilot state; this batch does not newly certify it.
status_definitions.reported_complete: Inherited completion report, not revalidated or promoted to complete.
status_definitions.blocked: Open source, runtime, response, or evidence gates prevent whole-workshop acceptance.
status_definitions.in_progress: Live work was active at capture time, not accepted.
status_definitions.pending: Live manual validation not yet completed or begun under this run.

acceptance_boundary: A passing response is not whole-workshop acceptance. Complete requires exact persisted inputs, all locked live cases with routing/retrieval/citation/safety checks, reviewed evidence for every declared step, source validation, and an observed unpublished Draft. Offline compilation and tests cannot supply live evidence.
publication_boundary: GitHub source preservation only. No tenant import, agent publication, new live validation or image review was performed in this batch.
unresolved_work: The two linked workshops remain blocked; historical failures and residual discrepancies are recorded in their review files.
Regulatory Compliance's five reported passing responses are not an independently proven full-final-revision pass set.
Portfolio Rebalancing was in progress; its three earlier failures and final regression were unresolved at capture time. No Portfolio repair is promoted here.
Building Permit Processing is blocked. No excluded offline worktree or source-only audit is used as live completion evidence.
Private state, raw browser wrappers, images, tenant/account identifiers and unrelated transcripts remain local.
